svg.text: Four-Case Composed Latency Ladder (NVIDIA B200, Measured)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 1 (Config): Live runtime reconfig in 3.7-5.2 ms (7 vLLM models, up to 491 GiB TP4)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 2 (Python): Live code swap in 61-92 ms (TRT-LLM 61.1 ms, SGLang 62.2 ms, vLLM 76-92 ms)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 3 (Graphs): Selective CUDA-graph recapture in 0.62-3.69 s (full 166-graph MoE: 10.52 s)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 4 (Crash): 0.31-1.86 s GMS Shadow or 2.73-6.96 s CRIU -> 61-91 ms live edit

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: *65.5 GB tier uses deterministic dummy BF16 weights (32.76B Qwen3ForCausalLM). Correctness: logprobs=5 max_abs_diff == 0.0 (vLLM & SGLang CRIU) and 3/3 bit-exact (TRT-LLM).
